recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic composition featuring a central male figure with surreal horn-like hair extensions, surrounded by ghostly, semi-transparent secondary portraits emerging from a smoky, dark atmosphere. The aesthetic is gritty and dramatic, utilizing metallic textures and sharp, chiseled typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure as the primary focal point with symmetrical secondary portraits
Textural interplay between smooth skin, metallic jewelry, and ethereal smoke
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows and bright highlights on metallic surfaces
Typography integrated into the upper third, acting as a crown to the central figure
coreInvariants: Metallic or chiseled texture on primary display text
Low-angle perspective on the central subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure occupies the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame; secondary figures are scaled down and positioned symmetrically in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's sunglasses and the large chiseled title text above the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large title, moves down to the central face, then radiates outward to the secondary portraits before settling on the metallic jewelry at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space at the edges and bottom, filled with subtle smoke textures to maintain focus on the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and charcoal grays for background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white and silver for highlights, jewelry, and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for smoke textures and skin gradients.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from absolute black to brilliant white.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast serif with sharp, elongated terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Internal textures resembling cracked stone or hammered metal
Variable stroke width with very thin horizontals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature 'cracked' or 'weathered' edges to mimic stone
Outer glow or drop shadow to separate from dark background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavily textured, chiseled display serif paired with a clean, widely-spaced sans-serif for contrast and legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric sans for the top metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a monochromatic, high-contrast portrait of a man with sunglasses and horn-shaped hair. Surround him with four smaller, ghostly, semi-transparent portraits of himself and children, all emerging from a thick, dark smoke background. Focus on metallic highlights on jewelry and skin texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered title in the upper third using a chiseled, cracked-stone serif font in silver. Above it, add a secondary name in a clean, widely-spaced white sans-serif. Ensure the main title sits slightly behind the subject's hair for depth.

verificationChecks: Does the main text have a chiseled, metallic texture?
Are the secondary portraits semi-transparent and blended with smoke?
Is the tracking on the top text significantly wide?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the chiseled texture on text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact placement of cracks in the typography

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of smoke and portraits
avoid: Muddy gray tones instead of deep blacks

postGenerationChecks: Check for zero color saturation across the entire image.
Ensure the 'chiseled' effect on the text looks three-dimensional.
Verify that the smoke does not obscure the primary facial features.
Confirm the hierarchy between the large serif and small sans-serif text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast monochromatic portrait with a 'double exposure' smoke effect, topped with chiseled, stone-textured display typography for a gritty, urban-surrealist aesthetic.
